name: Hanceville Knapsacks for Kids
summary: Volunteers pack weekend food bags for Hanceville students who might otherwise go without. Each bag costs about $12, and packing happens on Thursdays at the Civic Center.
how: Donate by Cash App to $knapsacks4 or by mail. Message their Facebook page to volunteer.

name: Lions' Kitchen at Wallace State
summary: A free food pantry for Wallace State students. You can give through the Wallace State Future Foundation.

name: Cullman Caring for Kids
summary: One of the busiest food pantries in Cullman County, serving about 900 to 1,000 families a month. They always welcome canned fruit and easy breakfast items.

name: Hanceville Friends of the Festival
summary: The volunteer group behind the Mud Creek Arts and Crafts Festival. Proceeds go to Hanceville schools and the city, and they welcome new vendors and sponsors.

name: Hanceville Civitan Club
summary: A local service club that hosts community events like pancake breakfasts.

name: Shirley Burden Public Library
summary: Gifts to the library are tax deductible, and used book sales help pay for children's programs. Every book you buy at the sale helps local kids.

name: Wallace State Future Foundation
summary: Raises money for more than 150 scholarships for Wallace State students.

name: The Willow Path
summary: Runs a 24 hour crisis line and an emergency shelter for people facing abuse in Cullman County.

name: Brooks' Place Child Advocacy Center
summary: Supports children who may have been abused, and their families, with a caring and coordinated response.

name: United Way of Cullman County
summary: Runs 211, the free line that connects people with local help, and supports partner agencies around the county.
